All tests pass and the reported case is fixed:

- `parse_flag("off ")` now returns `False` (previously `True`)
- Leading/trailing whitespace is ignored as the docstring promised
- Whitespace-only input now correctly raises `ValueError`
- `parse_flags("on, off ,yes")` still returns `[True, False, True]`

The fix was a one-line change: `text.lower()` → `text.strip().lower()` in `parse_flag`.
